facts.text: I asked how the agricultural industry has impacted the environment in California's Central Valley.
I asked whether there are efforts being made to mitigate negative environmental impacts from agriculture in the Central Valley.
I asked whether consumers can play a role in supporting sustainable farming practices.
I said it is important to make conscious choices as consumers.
I said it can be hard to know which brands are truly sustainable.
I asked for suggestions for reliable sources to check for certifications.
I said it is good to know there are reliable certifications to look for when shopping.
I asked for recommendations for specific brands or stores that prioritize sustainable farming practices in the Central Valley.
I said I appreciate the suggestions.
I said I will make sure to look out for those certifications and support sustainable farming in the Central Valley.
